{{Top|leg}}
The '''precision chamber''' was a [[firing chamber]] customization for many [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons that significantly broadened the energy beam, on a greater scale than the [[broadened chamber]], resulting in an increase in damage. The Mark I, II, & III versions in turn allowed for considerable boosts in the potential for a critical injury.
